view.name: Whiteboard overview
view.description: Main Excalidraw canvas zoomed to fit the whole planning board, showing all frames with the toolbar, zoom/undo controls and help.

regions.label: Hamburger main-menu button, centered floating shape-tool toolbar with keyboard-shortcut hints, Excalidraw+ trial link, Share button, Library toggle
Infinite drawing canvas at 23% zoom showing seven titled frames: architecture diagram, roadmap, schema, sprint board, flowchart, retro chart, archive
Zoom level, minimap toggle, undo/redo; encryption shield link and help button at right

evidence.note: Persistent tool toolbar: lock, hand, selection (active), rectangle, diamond, ellipse, arrow, line, draw, text, sticky note, eraser, more tools; each shows a shortcut letter
Named frame holding hand-drawn shapes and arrows

evidence.quote: To move canvas, hold Scroll wheel or Space while dragging, or use the hand tool

evidence.note: Grid of named frames: sprint board, checkout flowchart, reliability retro

Hamburger trigger; on the live page it opens a sectioned menu (Open Ctrl+O, Save to…, Export image…, Command palette, Find on canvas, Help, links, Preferences, Theme, Canvas background). Closed in the capture
Undo and redo buttons, disabled because there is no history yet
Only floating tool chrome around one document; no global navigation to other destinations

patterns.rationale: When I hovered a toolbar button on the live page, no custom tooltip appeared. Native title tooltips may exist but can't be seen.

evidence.note: Hovered the Rectangle tool live: no tooltip rendered
The sprint board is a static hand-drawn diagram on the canvas, not an interactive kanban UI
Bar chart is hand-drawn shapes, not a data-bound chart

structure.layout: full-bleed infinite canvas with floating chrome: hamburger menu top-left, centered tool toolbar, share/library top-right, and zoom/minimap/undo plus help in the bottom corners

aesthetics.typography: Assistant (UI sans) for toolbar, buttons, frame titles and hints; monospace for the keycaps in the hint ('Scroll wheel', 'Space'); canvas content uses Excalidraw's hand-drawn Excalifont/Virgil-style script
aesthetics.typeScale: Small, flat UI type: 16px for the toolbar and the trial link (500 weight), 13–14px for buttons, the zoom label and hints, and 10px shortcut letters under the tool icons. Little weight contrast; hierarchy comes from the canvas content, not the UI text

notes: Excalidraw: a white, flat canvas surrounded by floating, softly shadowed 8px-radius controls in lavender/indigo (#6965db primary, #e0dfff for the selected tool). Tool buttons show tiny shortcut letters in their bottom-right corners. Canvas content is hand-drawn (rough strokes, script font, pastel fills: yellow, blue, green, pink, purple) and organized into named frames: an architecture diagram, Q4 roadmap Gantt sketch, DB schema, sprint kanban sketch, checkout flowchart, retro notes with a drawn bar chart, and an archive. These are drawn artifacts, not live UI components. The hamburger main menu (seen live) includes a Command palette (Ctrl+/) and Find on canvas, which the capture doesn't show. The Excalidraw+ upsell link and the purple Share (live collaboration) button sit top-right.
